💾 Data & Backup
☁️
Firebase Cloud Sync
Your data syncs automatically. Switch devices anytime — everything stays in sync.
Checking sync status…
⚙️ One-time Firebase setup needed:
1. Open Firebase Console → Realtime Database
2. If no database exists: click Create database → choose us-central1 → Start in test mode
3. Click Rules tab → replace with:
{"rules":{".read":true,".write":"auth != null"}} 4. Click Publish — this allows anyone to READ (good for suppliers) but only you can WRITE
5. Go to Authentication → Enable Email/Password → Add your account
6. Come back here → Sign in → Push again
🔒 Link Firebase account — one time only
After this, cloud sync is automatic every time you log in to FAZZA
